text: All right, so the fast assistant with the help maybe of the master assistant can work together to keep the UI updated quickly. And the system auditor, we want to figure out how, we want to measure the timing of everything, from the time the prompt gets there to the time the UI gets updated, all the timing. And that should happen on the timeline generally, so it's all visual. Then the assistants can spawn masterminds. I think what the fast assistant can learn to do is relay the prompt to the proper mastermind. And the mastermind is a little bit slower, so it's going to take a minute to get the proper feedback, but the more we can offload to independent masterminds that are doing the deep reasoning and maybe spawning minions for parallelization. We want to build this into the right skill system, for the right roles. But I do think having these assistants that are not doing any deep reasoning, they're just sorting the messages essentially and deciding when to use their skills. So logging, everything that can be logged should be logged. The prompt that comes in gets logged immediately. We transform it, kind of summarize it, but I think maybe what I want to do is approve
